messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets.
Your doctor may occasionally change your dose.
Use the medicine exactly as directed.
Take empagliflozin once a day in the morning, with or without food.
Your blood sugar will need to be checked often.
You may also need to test the level of ketones in your urine.
Empagliflozin can cause life-threatening ketoacidosis (too much acid in the blood).
Contact your doctor if a urine test shows that you have high ketones in the urine.
Even if your blood sugar is normal.
Blood sugar can be affected by stress, illness, surgery, exercise, alcohol use, or skipping meals.
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia) can make you feel very hungry, dizzy, irritable, or shaky.
To quickly treat hypoglycemia, eat or drink hard candy, crackers, raisins, fruit juice, or non-diet soda.
Your doctor may prescribe glucagon injection in case of severe hypoglycemia.
You may get dehydrated during prolonged illness.
Call your doctor if you are sick with vomiting or diarrhea.
Triplet: ["hypoglycemia", "has treatment", "eat or drink hard candy, crackers, raisins, fruit juice, or non-diet soda"]

The relation 'has treatment' in the triplet is defined as 'The medical condition specified by the subject entity can be treated with the intervention specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has treatment requirement': The medical condition specified by the subject requires the treatment or management approach specified by the object entity.
B. 'are being treated with': The subject entity is receiving treatment with the substance or therapy specified by the object entity.
C. 'related to': The subject entity is associated with or connected to the medical condition or entity specified by the object entity.
D. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
